Diana.combo: When Diana uses E Lunar Rush without a mark or Diana W Pale Cascade ends, close the gap with Shyvana R Dragon's Descent. Slow her with Shyvana E Molten Burst, activate W Inferno Aegis to get close, then empower basic attacks with Q Emberstrike. If Diana looks likely to leave soon, recast W to detonate it.
Diana.build: Build magic resistance first to prepare for Diana’s damage. Keep stacking Shyvana P Scalemail, and shore up your durability with defensive items if it falls short in the late game.
Diana.escape: If you’re hit by Diana Q Crescent Strike’s mark, create distance first because Diana E Lunar Rush can come back in. Right after Diana uses E Lunar Rush without a mark, you have an opening to slow her with Shyvana E Molten Burst or engage with R Dragon's Descent.
Diana.fight: Dodge Diana Q Crescent Strike and trade after Diana W Pale Cascade ends. If Diana uses E Lunar Rush to engage without a mark, slow her with Shyvana E Molten Burst, then keep fighting.
Diana.phase: Early on, Shyvana’s ganks are weak too, so farm and get by. Stacking Shyvana P Scalemail makes the matchup increasingly favorable against Diana, but if your durability falls short in the late game, you can be melted first in a teamfight.
Diana.teamfight: Place vision on Diana’s flank approach and spread out from allies so you aren’t pulled in together by Diana R Moonfall. After an ally applies crowd control, engage so several enemies are caught in Shyvana R Dragon's Descent’s path. In dragon form, hit clustered enemies with Shyvana E Molten Burst and hit a champion with the W Inferno Aegis explosion to heal.
Diana.watch: Dodge Diana Q Crescent Strike by stepping to the side. If you’re hit by the mark, Diana E Lunar Rush resets, so create distance, and don’t fight until the orbs and shield from Diana W Pale Cascade disappear. In teamfights, spread out so several allies aren’t pulled in together by Diana R Moonfall.

Briar.laning: Prepare for Briar’s early ganks by avoiding long stays in areas without vision. Secure vision around pushed-in lanes to create a chance to counterattack if she forces an engage. Before an objective, build the Fury for Shyvana R Dragon's Descent and set up vision.
Briar.build: Build armor first to prepare for Briar’s main damage. Briar Q Head Rush reduces your resistances, so avoiding it is also important. If Briar’s healing makes the duel drag on, fit Executioner's Calling in after completing one core item.
Briar.combo: Pass through Briar with Shyvana R Dragon's Descent, then slow her with Shyvana E Molten Burst as she comes back around. Get close with Shyvana W Inferno Aegis to gain a shield, then use Shyvana Q Emberstrike with your next basic attack. If Briar looks likely to escape before the shield expires, recast Shyvana W Inferno Aegis to detonate it.
Briar.escape: Don’t engage just because Briar Q Head Rush is down; check whether Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack and Briar R Certain Death are also available. The window before Briar R Certain Death comes back up is especially good for closing the gap with Shyvana R Dragon's Descent. If Briar’s reliable crowd control engage is still available, time Shyvana R Dragon's Descent to pass through it during its unstoppable portion.
Briar.fight: Early on, focus on getting stronger instead of forcing duels, and fight once you have Shyvana R Dragon's Descent. If Briar dashes in, get a shield from Shyvana W Inferno Aegis, slow her with Shyvana E Molten Burst, then empower basic attacks with Shyvana Q Emberstrike. If Briar stays close, delay the Shyvana W Inferno Aegis explosion to make longer use of its movement speed; in dragon form, hit a champion with the explosion to heal.
Briar.phase: Early on, Briar has high kill participation and Shyvana’s ganks are weak, so farm and get by. Shyvana gains an advantage in this matchup as Shyvana P Scalemail stacks build, but you need stacks and defensive items to avoid being melted first in late-game teamfights.
Briar.teamfight: Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack targets the nearest enemy, so stand on the frontline to protect your backline damage dealers. Briar R Certain Death’s bloodstone also marks the first champion it hits, so you can take it before it reaches your backline damage dealers. After an ally applies crowd control, engage so several enemies are caught in Shyvana R Dragon's Descent’s path, then hit several enemies with Shyvana E Molten Burst and Shyvana W Inferno Aegis in dragon form.
Briar.watch: Briar Q Head Rush dashes in, stuns, and reduces armor and magic resistance, so watch your distance to avoid it. When Briar E Chilling Scream starts charging, don’t fight with your back to a wall. If Briar R Certain Death hits you and marks you as prey, move toward your allies and fight back together instead of fleeing alone.

Amumu.watch: Amumu Q Bandage Toss stuns you on hit, and Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy can then bind your allies along with you. Dodge Amumu Q Bandage Toss by putting a jungle monster between you, and don’t group with allies while Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy is available. Amumu W Despair keeps dealing damage based on your maximum health while you stay close, so limit how long you stay near him.
Amumu.build: Build magic resistance first to prepare for Amumu’s magic damage, and get movement speed to leave the range of Amumu W Despair. Don’t invest only in health, since that also increases Amumu W Despair’s damage. Keep stacking the armor and magic resistance from Shyvana P Scalemail.
Amumu.teamfight: Don’t group with allies while Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy is available; keep your distance in open terrain. After Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy is down or an ally applies crowd control, engage so several enemies are caught in Shyvana R Dragon's Descent’s path. Hit clustered enemies with Shyvana E Molten Burst in dragon form, and hit a champion with the Shyvana W Inferno Aegis explosion to heal.
Amumu.combo: When Amumu’s crowd control is down and you have an opening, close the gap with Shyvana R Dragon's Descent. Follow with Shyvana E Molten Burst to slow him, then stay close with Shyvana W Inferno Aegis active and empower basic attacks with Shyvana Q Emberstrike. If Amumu looks likely to escape before the shield expires, recast Shyvana W Inferno Aegis to detonate it immediately.
Amumu.escape: Amumu has no ability to create distance on his own, so the moment after Amumu Q Bandage Toss or Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy is down is your chance to engage. If you use Shyvana R Dragon's Descent then, Amumu will have trouble retreating. If his crowd control is still available, look for the right moment to use the unstoppable portion of Shyvana R Dragon's Descent’s travel.
Amumu.fight: Once you have Shyvana R Dragon's Descent, engage when Amumu Q Bandage Toss or Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy is down. If you get close, deal damage with Shyvana W Inferno Aegis’s explosion and basic attacks empowered by Shyvana Q Emberstrike, but don’t stay near Amumu W Despair for long.
Amumu.laning: Early on, clear camps with Shyvana E Molten Burst, Shyvana W Inferno Aegis, then Shyvana Q Emberstrike, while stacking Shyvana P Scalemail. Start looking for ganks in earnest once you have Shyvana R Dragon's Descent.
Amumu.phase: Shyvana gets strong in the mid game with Shyvana R Dragon's Descent, attack speed, and core items. Stacking makes you stronger into the late game, but without enough stacks and defensive items, Shyvana can be melted first in a teamfight.

Khazix.escape: Right after Kha'Zix E Leap is used to engage is your chance to go in with Shyvana R Dragon's Descent. If Kha'Zix goes invisible with Kha'Zix R Void Assault, don't blindly follow; wait with your allies for him to reveal himself.
Khazix.build: Build armor first against Kha'Zix's main damage. Keep stacking Shyvana P Scalemail to improve your durability. Kha'Zix W Void Spike provides healing, but unless healing is a major issue, don't rush Executioner's Calling just for that.
Khazix.combo: When Kha'Zix E Leap is down, approach with Shyvana R Dragon's Descent and slow him with Shyvana E Molten Burst. Then activate Shyvana W Inferno Aegis and weave Shyvana Q Emberstrike into a basic attack. If Kha'Zix tries to escape before the shield ends, stay close and recast Shyvana W Inferno Aegis to detonate it.
Khazix.fight: Close the gap with Shyvana R Dragon's Descent right after Kha'Zix E Leap is used to engage. Avoid isolation by staying near allies, then hold your ground with Shyvana W Inferno Aegis and weave Shyvana Q Emberstrike into a basic attack.
Khazix.laning: Don't let Kha'Zix read your position when you're pathing alone in the jungle, and secure vision in the river and jungle entrance bushes.
Khazix.phase: In the early game, Shyvana should farm to get by, and before Kha'Zix's first evolution, secure vision so you can go for objectives first. Shyvana becomes strong in fights in the mid game once she has attack speed and core items, but avoid acting alone if Kha'Zix has two or more evolutions. In the late game, Shyvana needs Shyvana P Scalemail stacks and defensive items to survive; with enough stacks, she gains the advantage as the game goes on.
Khazix.teamfight: Group with your allies in a narrow, warded area to prevent Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear's isolated damage. If an ally catches an enemy first, use Shyvana R Dragon's Descent to pass through several enemies, then hit clustered targets with Shyvana E Molten Burst. Fight while landing dragon-form Shyvana W Inferno Aegis's explosion on a champion to heal.
Khazix.watch: Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear deals much more damage when you're isolated, so don't enter fog of war alone. If Kha'Zix disappears with Kha'Zix R Void Assault, stay with your allies and wait for him to appear instead of chasing his position. If Kha'Zix E Leap is evolved, he can use it again after a takedown, so be careful about chasing right after an ally is picked off.

Brand.phase: Early on, Shyvana has weak ganks because she lacks crowd control, so focus on farming and getting by. Shyvana also benefits from stacking Shyvana P Scalemail into the late game, but without enough stacks and defensive items, you can be melted first.
Brand.build: Brand’s main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. Keep stacking Shyvana P Scalemail, and get movement speed to leave the warned attack zones.
Brand.combo: Engage with Shyvana R Dragon's Descent after Brand W Pillar of Flame is down. Slow Brand with Shyvana E Molten Burst as he comes back around, then activate Shyvana W Inferno Aegis to get close and empower basic attacks with Shyvana Q Emberstrike. If Brand tries to escape before the shield expires, recast Shyvana W Inferno Aegis to detonate it.
Brand.escape: The moment after Brand uses Brand W Pillar of Flame is your chance to engage. If you aren’t ablaze, Brand Q Sear can’t stun you, so close the gap with Shyvana R Dragon's Descent. If you are ablaze, dodge the Brand Q Sear projectile before going in.
Brand.fight: When Brand W Pillar of Flame is down and you aren’t ablaze, close the gap with Shyvana R Dragon's Descent. Brand has no mobility ability, so slow him with Shyvana E Molten Burst once you’re close, then empower basic attacks with Shyvana Q Emberstrike. Activate Shyvana W Inferno Aegis as you approach to use its shield and movement speed.
Brand.laning: When approaching Brand’s lane, avoid standing next to burning minions, and step aside in a wave where Brand E Conflagration can spread.
Brand.teamfight: Spread out from allies before engaging to avoid Brand E Conflagration spreading and Brand R Pyroclasm bouncing. After an ally applies crowd control, engage so several enemies are caught in Shyvana R Dragon's Descent’s path, then attack clustered enemies with Shyvana E Molten Burst. In dragon form, hit a champion with the Shyvana W Inferno Aegis explosion to heal and survive.
Brand.watch: Brand P Blaze stacks and explodes when you’re hit by consecutive abilities, so dodge the first one, Brand Q Sear or Brand W Pillar of Flame. If you’re ablaze, Brand Q Sear stuns you, so get out of its projectile path or hide behind minions. When you see Brand R Pyroclasm, spread out from allies to reduce its bouncing damage.

Ivern.fight: Close the gap with Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent just after Ivern Q Rootcaller is down. If your target is already affected by Ivern E Triggerseed, engage after the shield bursts, then deal damage with Shyvana E Molten Burst’s slow and auto attacks empowered by Shyvana Q Emberstrike. Don’t chase far when only Ivern remains.
Ivern.build: Prioritize attack speed to increase Shyvana Q Emberstrike’s frequency. If you build resistance against Ivern’s damage, magic resistance is more appropriate than armor, but tenacity is a better priority against the risk of allies closing in during the crowd control from Ivern Q Rootcaller and Ivern R Daisy!.
Ivern.combo: After Ivern Q Rootcaller is down and Ivern E Triggerseed has burst, pass through your target with Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent. Slow them with Shyvana E Molten Burst as they come back around, activate Shyvana W Inferno Aegis as you close in, then empower an auto attack with Shyvana Q Emberstrike. If they look likely to flee soon, recast Shyvana W Inferno Aegis to land the explosion.
Ivern.escape: Ivern Q Rootcaller is both his root and his means of movement, so the moment after he uses it is your window to engage with Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent. Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent makes you unstoppable while moving, but delay your engage against a target affected by Ivern E Triggerseed until the shield bursts.
Ivern.laning: Ward Ivern’s jungle early to track his path as he comes to farm camps, and pressure him there when you get the chance. Watch for ambushes before passing near newly created Ivern W Brushmaker bushes.
Ivern.phase: Early on, Shyvana should farm to scale rather than focus on ganking, and use vision to read Ivern’s predictable camp route and find an opening. Shyvana P Scalemail stacks can make the matchup more favorable as the game goes on, but without enough stacks and defensive items, you can be melted first in a late-game team fight.
Ivern.teamfight: After an ally applies crowd control, engage along a path that catches several enemies with Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent. Don’t dash straight at a target affected by Ivern E Triggerseed; after the shield bursts, target the ally Ivern was protecting. When using Shyvana E Molten Burst on an enemy behind Ivern R Daisy!, check whether Daisy will be hit first.
Ivern.watch: If Ivern Q Rootcaller roots you, Ivern’s allies can dash in, so avoid giving him an angle by keeping minions or terrain between you and him before he throws it. If you approach a target affected by Ivern E Triggerseed right away, you’ll also be slowed when the shield bursts, so wait for the explosion. If Ivern R Daisy! starts hitting you, move away to interrupt her three consecutive attacks.

Nidalee.build: Build magic resistance against Nidalee's main damage. If she heals with Nidalee E Primal Surge and drags out the fight, fit Executioner's Calling into your build after completing one core item.
Nidalee.combo: When Nidalee W Pounce is down, close the gap with Shyvana R Dragon's Descent and slow her with Shyvana E Molten Burst. Activate Shyvana W Inferno Aegis, stick to her, and weave Shyvana Q Emberstrike into your basic attacks. If Nidalee looks likely to escape before the shield expires, recast Shyvana W Inferno Aegis to detonate it.
Nidalee.escape: The moment after you bait out Nidalee W Pounce is your chance to engage with Shyvana R Dragon's Descent. Nidalee has no crowd control, but if Nidalee Q Javelin Toss or Nidalee W Bushwhack hits you and marks you, save Shyvana W Inferno Aegis to prepare for Nidalee's leap.
Nidalee.fight: Focus on farming instead of forcing fights early, and engage once you have Shyvana R Dragon's Descent. After Nidalee uses Nidalee W Pounce, close the gap with Shyvana R Dragon's Descent, slow her with Shyvana E Molten Burst, then stick to her and fight.
Nidalee.laning: Check for Nidalee W Bushwhack at river and jungle entrances with a Control Ward or an area-of-effect ability before moving through, and build up enough Fury for Shyvana R Dragon's Descent before fighting over an objective.
Nidalee.phase: Shyvana's ganks are weak early, so farm while dodging Nidalee's spears and traps. Shyvana P Scalemail stacks help later, but with too few stacks and defensive items, you can be melted first in a team fight.
Nidalee.teamfight: Dodge the path of Nidalee Q Javelin Toss and watch where Nidalee steps out to throw it. After your allies apply crowd control, use Shyvana R Dragon's Descent to hit multiple enemies in a line, then hit the clustered enemies with Shyvana E Molten Burst. In dragon form, hit champions with the explosion from Shyvana W Inferno Aegis to heal.
Nidalee.watch: Nidalee Q Javelin Toss deals more damage the farther it travels, so dodge its path or get behind your team's frontline. Nidalee W Bushwhack also leaves a Hunt mark, so check jungle entrances and the river. If you get marked, save Shyvana W Inferno Aegis so you can use it when Nidalee W Pounce jumps in.

Belveth.build: Build armor first to prepare for Bel'Veth Q Void Surge and Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom. If the healing from Bel'Veth R Endless Banquet is a problem, fit Executioner's Calling in after completing one core item. You can’t mitigate R’s true damage with resistances, so get health too.
Belveth.combo: When Bel'Veth W Above and Below is down, close the gap with Shyvana R Dragon's Descent and slow her with Shyvana E Molten Burst. Activate Shyvana W Inferno Aegis, get close, and empower basic attacks with Shyvana Q Emberstrike. If Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom activates, land the Shyvana W Inferno Aegis explosion after it ends.
Belveth.escape: Don’t engage just because Bel'Veth Q Void Surge has been used once. Dodge Bel'Veth W Above and Below, then look for an opening to close the gap with Shyvana R Dragon's Descent before Q comes back up.
Belveth.fight: Dodge Bel'Veth W Above and Below to the side, then close the gap with Shyvana R Dragon's Descent. Save the Shyvana W Inferno Aegis explosion and Shyvana Q Emberstrike while Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom is active; when it ends, get close and deal damage. If Bel'Veth tries to escape, recast Shyvana W Inferno Aegis to land the explosion.
Belveth.laning: Early on, farm camps to grow instead of forcing Shyvana’s weak ganks. Before an objective fight, build the Fury needed for Shyvana R Dragon's Descent and set up vision so you can start the objective first.
Belveth.phase: Fight aggressively in the mid game once you have Shyvana R Dragon's Descent, attack speed, and core items. Bel'Veth’s permanent stacks can build up in the late game while Shyvana’s durability falls short, so get stacks on Shyvana P Scalemail and defensive items.
Belveth.teamfight: After an ally applies crowd control, find an angle for Shyvana R Dragon's Descent to pass through several enemies. Hit clustered enemies with Shyvana E Molten Burst in dragon form, and hit a champion with the Shyvana W Inferno Aegis explosion to heal. If an ally falls and a Void Coral appears, retreat before Bel'Veth picks it up, and delay the teamfight while Bel'Veth is transformed.
Belveth.watch: Bel'Veth W Above and Below knocks up and slows you, and helps refresh Bel'Veth Q Void Surge. When Bel'Veth closes in, turn to the side to dodge W instead of running straight back. Save Shyvana’s burst damage while Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom is spinning, then deal it after it ends.

Ekko.build: Complete one core item first, and if Ekko’s healing makes the fight drag on, fit Executioner's Calling in. Build magic resistance rather than armor to prepare for Ekko’s main damage, and keep stacking Shyvana P Scalemail.
Ekko.combo: Activate Shyvana W Inferno Aegis as you approach, and close the gap with Shyvana R Dragon's Descent while Ekko R Chronobreak is down. Follow with Shyvana E Molten Burst to slow him, then empower basic attacks with Shyvana Q Emberstrike. If Ekko looks likely to escape before the shield expires, recast Shyvana W Inferno Aegis as soon as you’re close to detonate it.
Ekko.escape: Don’t rush in when only Ekko E Phase Dive is down, since Ekko can escape with Ekko R Chronobreak. Avoid Ekko W Parallel Convergence, then engage with Shyvana R Dragon's Descent before Ekko R Chronobreak comes back up. If both Ekko W Parallel Convergence and Ekko R Chronobreak are down, that’s a good window to start a full fight.
Ekko.fight: Early on, avoid forcing trades and start fighting once you have Shyvana R Dragon's Descent. Avoid the area of Ekko W Parallel Convergence, and close the gap with Shyvana R Dragon's Descent when Ekko R Chronobreak is down. Once close, slow him with Shyvana E Molten Burst and empower basic attacks with Shyvana Q Emberstrike.
Ekko.laning: Get through the early game by avoiding the return path of Ekko Q Timewinder and the marked area of Ekko W Parallel Convergence. Set up vision to start dragon and Herald first, and build the Fury needed for Shyvana R Dragon's Descent before an objective fight.
Ekko.phase: Shyvana’s ganks are weak early, so farm and get by. The more you stack, the more favorable the matchup becomes against Ekko, but without enough Shyvana P Scalemail stacks and defensive items in the late game, you can be the first to fall in a teamfight.
Ekko.teamfight: Avoid the marked area of Ekko W Parallel Convergence, and if possible, engage after both Ekko W Parallel Convergence and Ekko R Chronobreak are down. When an ally applies crowd control, go in so several enemies are caught in Shyvana R Dragon's Descent’s path. In dragon form, hit clustered enemies with Shyvana E Molten Burst and hit a champion with the Shyvana W Inferno Aegis explosion to heal.
Ekko.watch: When you see the signal for Ekko W Parallel Convergence, leave its area to avoid the stun and shield. Also step aside from the return path of Ekko Q Timewinder. If you see Ekko’s afterimage behind him, Ekko R Chronobreak is ready, so don’t chase recklessly even when health is low.

Elise.build: Build magic resistance first to prepare for Elise’s main ability damage. Get armor too because she also deals basic attack damage, and if a trade drags on because of the healing from Elise P Spider Queen, fit Executioner's Calling in after completing one core item.
Elise.combo: When engaging, close the gap with Shyvana R Dragon's Descent, then slow her with Shyvana E Molten Burst. Activate Shyvana W Inferno Aegis and get close, then empower basic attacks with Shyvana Q Emberstrike. If Elise looks likely to escape before the shield expires, recast Shyvana W Inferno Aegis as soon as you’re close to detonate it.
Elise.escape: The moment after Elise uses Elise Q Neurotoxin / Venomous Bite is your chance to close the gap. Especially if Elise E Cocoon and E Rappel are both down, engage with Shyvana R Dragon's Descent.
Elise.fight: Early on, focus on getting stronger instead of forcing a fight. Once both Elise E Cocoon and E Rappel are down, engage with Shyvana R Dragon's Descent, land the slow from Shyvana E Molten Burst, and attack with basic attacks empowered by Shyvana Q Emberstrike.
Elise.laning: Set up plenty of vision to avoid giving Elise early gank kills, and don’t push the lane recklessly while Elise is missing.
Elise.phase: Early on, focus on farming with Shyvana while watching out for Elise looking to gain an advantage through ganks. In the late game, get stacks on Shyvana P Scalemail and defensive items so you aren’t the first to fall in a teamfight.
Elise.teamfight: After an ally applies crowd control, use Shyvana R Dragon's Descent along a path that passes through several enemies. Hit clustered enemies with Shyvana E Molten Burst, and hit a champion with the Shyvana W Inferno Aegis explosion among several enemies to heal.
Elise.watch: Dodge Cocoon by putting a minion or jungle monster between you and Elise. If Elise transforms with Elise R Spider Form when health has decreased, use Shyvana W Inferno Aegis to prepare for her finishing attack.

Evelynn.build: Build magic resistance first to prepare for Evelynn’s main damage. Evelynn W Allure reduces magic resistance, and Evelynn E Whiplash deals damage based on maximum health, so get movement speed to retreat before the mark completes instead of investing heavily in health alone. If Evelynn’s healing is enough to prolong the fight, fit Executioner's Calling in after completing one core item.
Evelynn.combo: When ganking, pass through the target with Shyvana R Dragon's Descent, then slow Evelynn with Shyvana E Molten Burst as she comes back around. Activate Shyvana W Inferno Aegis and get close, then empower basic attacks with Shyvana Q Emberstrike. If Evelynn tries to escape before the shield expires, recast Shyvana W Inferno Aegis to detonate it.
Evelynn.escape: Before Evelynn W Allure’s mark completes, retreat with the movement speed from Shyvana W Inferno Aegis. When engaging, don’t chase just because Evelynn E Whiplash is down; look for a window when Evelynn R Last Caress is also down and has not come off cooldown yet. Close the gap then with Shyvana R Dragon's Descent.
Evelynn.fight: Prepare Shyvana R Dragon's Descent and your Fury gauge, and avoid forcing damage trades before Evelynn W Allure’s mark completes. When Evelynn R Last Caress is down, close the gap with Shyvana R Dragon's Descent, then slow her with Shyvana E Molten Burst and empower basic attacks with Shyvana Q Emberstrike. Use the shield from Shyvana W Inferno Aegis while you’re close, and recast it to detonate if Evelynn tries to escape.
Evelynn.phase: As you build up through the game, you can gain an advantage against Evelynn, but without enough Shyvana P Scalemail stacks and defensive items in the late game, you can be melted first.
Evelynn.teamfight: Evelynn targets backline damage dealers, so keep your allied damage dealers in secured vision and save your allies’ immobilizing crowd control for her engage. After an ally applies crowd control, Shyvana should engage so several enemies are caught in Shyvana R Dragon's Descent’s path. Hit clustered enemies with Shyvana E Molten Burst in dragon form, and hit a champion with the Shyvana W Inferno Aegis explosion to heal.
Evelynn.watch: If you see the mark from Evelynn W Allure, use the movement speed from Shyvana W Inferno Aegis to retreat before the charm completes. After the charm, the max-health-based damage from Evelynn E Whiplash is dangerous, so avoid narrow paths and stay within your allies’ vision. If health has dropped, this is a range where Evelynn R Last Caress’s damage rises sharply, so don’t stay in areas without vision.

Fiddlesticks.build: Magic resistance is more effective than armor against Fiddlesticks’ damage, so build magic resistance. If the healing from Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest is a problem, fit Executioner’s Calling into your build after completing one core item.
Fiddlesticks.combo: Approach with Shyvana W Inferno Aegis, engage with Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent, then slow with Shyvana E Molten Burst. Stay close and apply Shyvana Q Emberstrike to an empowered basic attack. If Fiddlesticks tries to get away, recast Shyvana W Inferno Aegis to detonate it.
Fiddlesticks.escape: The window while Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm is down is your chance to engage. Once you confirm that Fiddlesticks Q Terrify and Fiddlesticks E Reap are also down, close the gap with Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent. If Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm is already active, move out of its area.
Fiddlesticks.fight: When Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm is down, close the gap with Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent. Letting Fiddlesticks channel W Bountiful Harvest to completion benefits its healing and cooldown, so use the movement speed from Shyvana W Inferno Aegis to control the distance instead of fighting him there for too long.
Fiddlesticks.laning: Prepare for Fiddlesticks’ ambushes by securing vision in the bushes behind your lane and along paths into objectives. Don’t walk past a stationary Scarecrow Effigy before checking it.
Fiddlesticks.phase: Shyvana is strong in the mid game as she builds attack speed and core items. Scaling stacks help more as the game goes on, but in the late game, you can be melted first in team fights if you lack Shyvana P Scalemail stacks and defensive items.
Fiddlesticks.teamfight: Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest, Fiddlesticks E Reap, and Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm all deal area damage, so spread out from your allies and don’t enter narrow paths without vision as a group. After an ally applies crowd control, find an angle with Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent that passes through several enemies, then hit champions with the piercing Shyvana E Molten Burst and Shyvana W Inferno Aegis explosion.
Fiddlesticks.watch: Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm appears after channeling and deals damage in an area. If you see him cast it, interrupt him with Shyvana E Molten Burst’s slow; if that fails, move out of range. If Fiddlesticks has been out of sight for a while, watch for ambushes from bushes and for Terrify from abilities cast out of sight.

Gragas.build: Gragas’ main damage is magic, so prioritize magic resistance over armor. Gragas W Drunken Rage deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid building only health, and get movement speed to leave telegraphed areas. If healing from Gragas P Happy Hour makes fights drag on, fit Executioner’s Calling into your build after completing one core item.
Gragas.combo: When Gragas E Body Slam is down, close the gap with Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent and slow him with Shyvana E Molten Burst. Stay close with Shyvana W Inferno Aegis while empowering an auto attack with Shyvana Q Emberstrike. If Gragas looks likely to get away before the shield expires, recast Shyvana W Inferno Aegis to detonate it.
Gragas.escape: The moment after Gragas uses E Body Slam is your window to engage. Gragas E Body Slam’s cooldown is greatly reduced when it hits an enemy, so don’t chase far unless you can secure the kill. If Gragas tries to start a fight with E Body Slam while you still have Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent, you can pass through its crowd control during the unstoppable part of your dash.
Gragas.fight: Don’t commit heavy damage while Gragas is drinking with W Drunken Rage; wait for its damage reduction to end. Just after Gragas uses E Body Slam, approach with Shyvana W Inferno Aegis and close the gap with Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent. Once close, slow him with Shyvana E Molten Burst and empower an auto attack with Shyvana Q Emberstrike.
Gragas.laning: Hit a large monster with Shyvana E Molten Burst, then activate Shyvana W Inferno Aegis, move in close, and empower a basic attack with Shyvana Q Emberstrike.
Gragas.phase: Early on, watch for Gragas’ burst and ability to disrupt your formation while Shyvana farms and holds on. Gragas’ sustained damage weakens as the game goes on, improving the matchup, but in the late game Shyvana can be melted first in a team fight if she lacks Shyvana P Scalemail stacks and defensive items.
Gragas.teamfight: Don’t leave your backline allies alone within reach of Gragas E Body Slam. If hit, immediately move out of Gragas Q Barrel Roll’s radius. After an ally applies crowd control, engage along a path that catches several enemies with Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent. In dragon form, hit grouped enemies with Shyvana E Molten Burst, then hit champions with the Shyvana W Inferno Aegis explosion to heal.
Gragas.watch: When you see Gragas Q Barrel Roll, leave its radius before it explodes. If Gragas E Body Slam hits you near a barrel, you’re likely to also get knocked up and hit by R Explosive Cask. When Gragas has R Explosive Cask available, don’t stand with an enemy turret or the enemy team at your back.

Graves.build: Graves’ main damage is physical, so buy Plated Steelcaps earlier and build armor first.
Graves.combo: Close the gap with Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent and slow with Shyvana E Molten Burst, then activate Shyvana W Inferno Aegis and stay close while empowering an auto attack with Shyvana Q Emberstrike. If Graves looks likely to escape before the shield expires, recast Shyvana W Inferno Aegis as soon as you get close to detonate it.
Graves.escape: If only Graves E Quickdraw is down, he can still escape with Graves R Collateral Damage, so don’t rush your engage. In particular, look to close the gap with Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent before Graves R Collateral Damage comes back up.
Graves.fight: Graves’ basic attacks are blocked by the first unit they hit, so fight with an ally or minion between you and him when possible. When Graves fires two shots and reloads, close in with Shyvana W Inferno Aegis, slow him with Shyvana E Molten Burst, then empower an auto attack with Shyvana Q Emberstrike.
Graves.laning: Pressure Graves where he farms early to slow his scaling stacks, and build Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent’s Fury before fighting over objectives.
Graves.phase: Shyvana has weak ganks early, so farm to scale and focus on denying Graves time to build stacks. Graves’ stacks become powerful later while Shyvana may become less durable, so build Shyvana P Scalemail stacks and defensive items.
Graves.teamfight: After an ally applies crowd control, engage along a path that catches several enemies with Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent. Hit grouped enemies with dragon-form Shyvana E Molten Burst, then hit champions with the Shyvana W Inferno Aegis explosion to heal. When taking Graves’ basic attacks, keep an ally or another unit between you and him whenever possible.
Graves.watch: Graves Q End of the Line detonates immediately when it hits terrain, so don’t fight with your back to a wall or in a narrow jungle passage. If Graves W Smoke Screen catches you, it blocks your vision and slows you; take the shortest path out of its area, then re-engage.

Hecarim.build: Prioritize armor to mitigate the main damage from Hecarim Q Rampage and Hecarim E Devastating Charge. If Hecarim sustains himself with W Spirit of Dread, fit Executioner’s Calling into your build after completing one core item.
Hecarim.combo: If Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows is not back up yet, close the gap with Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent. Then slow him with Shyvana E Molten Burst, close in with Shyvana W Inferno Aegis, and empower an auto attack with Shyvana Q Emberstrike. If Hecarim looks likely to escape soon, recast Shyvana W Inferno Aegis as soon as you get close to detonate it.
Hecarim.escape: If only Hecarim E Devastating Charge is down, he can still escape with Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows, so don’t chase recklessly. In particular, the window before Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows comes back up is your chance to engage with Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent. If you need to push through Hecarim’s fear, use the unstoppable part of Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent then.
Hecarim.fight: When a fight starts, land the slow from Shyvana E Molten Burst first to reduce both Hecarim’s movement speed and damage.
Hecarim.laning: Before an objective fight, fill the Fury gauge for Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent and secure vision so you can start the objective first.
Hecarim.phase: In the mid game, Shyvana becomes strong as she builds attack speed and core items. The more Shyvana stacks, the more favorable the matchup against Hecarim becomes, but in the late game, compensate for her low health growth with Shyvana P Scalemail stacks and defensive items.
Hecarim.teamfight: Spread out so Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows doesn’t fear several of you at once. After an ally applies crowd control, find an angle with Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent that passes through several enemies, then slow Hecarim with Shyvana E Molten Burst. Hit champions with the Shyvana W Inferno Aegis explosion to heal, but avoid having several allies fight for too long around Hecarim W Spirit of Dread.
Hecarim.watch: Hecarim E Devastating Charge deals more damage and knocks back farther the farther he runs. If he turns and starts running, break his vision or move close to an ally. Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows can fear several people, so spread out in team fights.

JarvanIV.build: Then also build attack speed to increase Shyvana Q Emberstrike’s frequency.
JarvanIV.teamfight: After an ally applies crowd control, engage along a path that catches several enemies with Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent, and hit grouped enemies with the piercing Shyvana E Molten Burst. Position yourself so the dragon-form Shyvana W Inferno Aegis explosion hits champions and heals you.

Jax.build: Prioritize attack speed to increase Shyvana Q Emberstrike’s frequency. Jax Q Leap Strike deals physical damage, while Jax W Empower and Jax E Counter Strike deal magic damage, so build both armor and magic resistance. Lowering Jax’s attack speed is also effective.
Jax.combo: Engage with Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent after Jax E Counter Strike ends and Jax has used Q Leap Strike. Slow him with Shyvana E Molten Burst, activate Shyvana W Inferno Aegis and close in, then empower an auto attack with Shyvana Q Emberstrike. If Jax looks likely to escape before the shield expires, recast Shyvana W Inferno Aegis to detonate it.
Jax.escape: The moment after Jax uses Q Leap Strike is your window to engage with Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent. Check that Jax E Counter Strike has also ended before going in; if it’s active, move out of stun range.
Jax.fight: Look for a trade after Jax E Counter Strike is down. If Jax has also used Q Leap Strike, close the gap with Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent, land Shyvana E Molten Burst’s slow, then hit him with auto attacks and Shyvana Q Emberstrike.
Jax.phase: In the late game, your accumulated P Scalemail stacks work in your favor, but without enough stacks and defensive items, you can be melted first in a team fight.
Jax.teamfight: When Jax jumps in with E Counter Strike active, don’t group around him and get caught in its area stun. After Counter Strike ends and an ally applies crowd control, engage along a path that catches several enemies with Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent, then make use of the empowered Shyvana E Molten Burst and the area effect of Shyvana W Inferno Aegis.
Jax.watch: When Jax E Counter Strike is active, it negates auto attacks empowered by Shyvana Q Emberstrike, and its reactivation damage increases with each attack dodged. Stop auto attacking, move out of its stun range, and wait for Counter Strike to end.

Karthus.build: Karthus Q Lay Waste, E Defile, and R Requiem all deal magic damage, so prioritize magic resistance over armor. However, Karthus W Wall of Pain reduces your resistance if you walk through it, so first use the movement speed from Shyvana W Inferno Aegis to get out of the wall and Karthus E Defile’s area.
Karthus.combo: Slow Karthus as he comes back around with Shyvana E Molten Burst, close in with Shyvana W Inferno Aegis, then land an auto attack empowered by Shyvana Q Emberstrike. If Karthus looks likely to get away before the shield ends, recast W Inferno Aegis to land the explosion.
Karthus.escape: Karthus has no ability to create distance, so your opportunity to engage is when Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent is available and you can approach him. If Karthus W Wall of Pain is cast, don’t go straight through it; approach from around the wall.
Karthus.fight: Karthus has no ability to create distance, so close in with R Dragon’s Descent and pressure him with Shyvana E Molten Burst’s slow and auto attacks empowered by Shyvana Q Emberstrike. If you kill him, move away immediately to avoid damage from Karthus P Death Defied.
Karthus.laning: Early on, hit a camp’s large monster with Shyvana E Molten Burst, activate Shyvana W Inferno Aegis as you close in, then clear it with auto attacks empowered by Shyvana Q Emberstrike. If your health is low after a fight, recall with Karthus R Requiem in mind.
Karthus.phase: In the late game, you can be melted first if you lack Shyvana P Scalemail stacks and defensive items, so keep developing and building durability.
Karthus.teamfight: After an ally applies crowd control, engage along a path that catches several enemies with Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent. Dragon-form Shyvana E Molten Burst pierces enemies, and you can heal if the Shyvana W Inferno Aegis explosion hits a champion. Even after killing Karthus, Karthus P Death Defied continues dealing damage, so move away from his corpse.
Karthus.watch: Karthus Q Lay Waste deals more damage when it hits you alone, so walk away when you see its detonation warning and, if possible, stand on top of an ally or minion. Karthus W Wall of Pain reduces your magic resistance and slows you, so go around the wall. Right after killing Karthus, move away from his corpse to avoid Q Lay Waste and E Defile from Karthus P Death Defied. After a fight, keep enough health to survive the global damage from Karthus R Requiem.

Kayn.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Kayn Q Reaping Slash, W Blade's Reach, and R Umbral Trespass. Stacking health alone also increases the damage from Kayn Q Reaping Slash. If Kayn transforms into his Darkin form and keeps healing, fit Executioner's Calling in after completing one core item.
Kayn.combo: Dodge Kayn W Blade's Reach, then close the gap with Shyvana R Dragon's Descent while Kayn R Umbral Trespass is down. Follow with Shyvana E Molten Burst to slow him, then stay close with Shyvana W Inferno Aegis active and weave Shyvana Q Emberstrike into a basic attack. If Kayn looks likely to escape before the shield explodes, recast Shyvana W Inferno Aegis to detonate it.
Kayn.escape: If only Kayn Q Reaping Slash is down, don't rush in, since Kayn can escape with Kayn R Umbral Trespass. Look for an opening after Kayn W Blade's Reach is also dodged and before Kayn R Umbral Trespass comes back, then engage with Shyvana R Dragon's Descent. If you need to push through the crowd control on Kayn W Blade's Reach, use Shyvana R Dragon's Descent's unstoppable window.
Kayn.fight: Pressure Kayn's early jungle pathing before he transforms, but don't force fights and give up kills. After dodging Kayn W Blade's Reach, use Shyvana W Inferno Aegis's move speed to close in, slow him with Shyvana E Molten Burst, then weave Shyvana Q Emberstrike into a basic attack. If Kayn E Shadow Step takes him into a wall, damage him with Shyvana E Molten Burst to shorten its duration.
Kayn.laning: Exploit Kayn's weak period before he transforms by pressuring his jungle pathing and objectives to delay his transformation. If Kayn E Shadow Step's warning appears along the edge of terrain, don't keep fighting there; retreat toward your turret.
Kayn.phase: Shyvana gains an advantage as she builds stacks, but if she lacks Shyvana P Scalemail stacks and defensive items in the late game, she can be burst down first in a team fight.
Kayn.teamfight: After an ally applies crowd control, engage so Shyvana R Dragon's Descent passes through several enemies, then hit clustered enemies with Shyvana E Molten Burst's piercing attack. Time dragon-form Shyvana W Inferno Aegis to hit a champion with its explosion and heal. If Kayn R Umbral Trespass enters an ally, keep in mind that he will emerge near his target and respond accordingly.
Kayn.watch: Dodge the straight-line hit from Kayn W Blade's Reach to prevent him from following up from long range with Kayn R Umbral Trespass. Kayn Q Reaping Slash deals damage based on your max health, so don't build only health to face him. If Kayn E Shadow Step's warning appears along the edge of terrain, stop fighting and back away.

Kindred.build: Build armor first to mitigate the physical damage from Kindred Q Dance of Arrows and Kindred E Mounting Dread. Keep stacking Shyvana P Scalemail to improve your durability. If the healing from Kindred W Wolf's Frenzy and Kindred R Lamb's Respite makes the duel drag on, fit Executioner's Calling in after completing one core item.
Kindred.combo: Close the gap with Shyvana R Dragon's Descent while Kindred W Wolf's Frenzy is down. Slow with Shyvana E Molten Burst, then activate Shyvana W Inferno Aegis as you approach and weave Shyvana Q Emberstrike into a basic attack. If Kindred looks likely to escape before the shield expires, recast Shyvana W Inferno Aegis to detonate it immediately.
Kindred.escape: If only Kindred Q Dance of Arrows is down, Kindred can still escape with Kindred W Wolf's Frenzy. Look for an opening before Kindred W Wolf's Frenzy comes back and close the gap with Shyvana R Dragon's Descent. Shyvana has no way to lock down an enemy, so don't chase far while Kindred still has a mobility ability available.
Kindred.fight: Farm and scale early, then look for fights once you have Shyvana R Dragon's Descent. When Kindred W Wolf's Frenzy is down, close the gap with Shyvana R Dragon's Descent, slow with Shyvana E Molten Burst, then weave Shyvana Q Emberstrike into a basic attack. Activate Shyvana W Inferno Aegis as you approach to use its shield and move speed.
Kindred.laning: Take jungle camps marked by Kindred P Mark of the Kindred first, or ward nearby to delay Kindred from claiming the mark. Before dragon and Herald, build up the Fury needed for Shyvana R Dragon's Descent and secure vision so you can start them first.
Kindred.phase: Shyvana's early ganks are weak, so farm and survive. In the late game, Shyvana has the advantage if she has enough Shyvana P Scalemail stacks, but she can be burst down first in a team fight without enough stacks and defensive items.
Kindred.teamfight: After an ally applies crowd control, engage so several enemies are caught in Shyvana R Dragon's Descent's path. Hit clustered enemies with dragon-form Shyvana E Molten Burst, and land Shyvana W Inferno Aegis's explosion on a champion to heal. If Kindred R Lamb's Respite is active, have low-health allies enter the zone too to receive protection and the heal when it ends.
Kindred.watch: If Kindred E Mounting Dread is applied to you, create distance or break vision so you don't get hit repeatedly. The more health you've lost, the more dangerous it is, so don't stay close after losing health. Kindred often uses Kindred Q Dance of Arrows to escape inside Kindred W Wolf's Frenzy, so don't chase recklessly.

LeeSin.build: Build armor first against Lee Sin's main damage from Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike and R Dragon's Rage. Keep stacking Shyvana P Scalemail to improve your durability in the late game.
LeeSin.combo: For camps, hit the large monster with Shyvana E Molten Burst, activate Shyvana W Inferno Aegis as you close in, then clear the camp with basic attacks empowered by Shyvana Q Emberstrike. To target Lee Sin, close the gap with Shyvana R Dragon's Descent before Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike comes back, slow with Shyvana E Molten Burst, then attack with a basic attack empowered by Shyvana Q Emberstrike. If Lee Sin looks likely to escape before the shield explodes, recast Shyvana W Inferno Aegis as soon as you close in to detonate it.
LeeSin.escape: If only Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike is down, don't immediately go in, since he can escape with Lee Sin W Safeguard / Iron Will. Look for an opening before Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike comes back; if Lee Sin has just used Lee Sin W Safeguard / Iron Will to engage, close in with Shyvana R Dragon's Descent and focus your damage.
LeeSin.fight: Don't take early duels with Lee Sin; clear camps and scale. If Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike misses or has not come off cooldown yet, close the gap with Shyvana R Dragon's Descent and fight up close with Shyvana W Inferno Aegis's shield active.
LeeSin.laning: Secure vision before dragon and Herald, and build up the Fury needed for Shyvana R Dragon's Descent.
LeeSin.phase: Lee Sin is strong in early duels, so back off and use farming and objective gains to buy time. Shyvana gains the advantage as the game goes on, but in the late game she needs Shyvana P Scalemail stacks and defensive items to make up for her weak health scaling.
LeeSin.teamfight: Spread out so a kick from Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage doesn't cause allies to be hit together, and position with a wall or your frontline behind you. After an ally applies crowd control, engage so several enemies are caught in Shyvana R Dragon's Descent's path. In dragon form, hit clustered enemies with Shyvana E Molten Burst and land Shyvana W Inferno Aegis's explosion on a champion to heal.
LeeSin.watch: If health is at half or below, stay by an allied turret or the team while the second hit is still available. Lee Sin W Safeguard / Iron Will can take him over an unseen wall, so stand away from walls.

Lillia.build: Build magic resistance first against Lillia's main ability damage, and get some armor to account for her basic attacks. If healing from Lillia P Dream-Laden Bough is a problem, fit Executioner's Calling in after completing one core item. Lillia P Dream-Laden Bough deals damage based on your max health, so avoid stacking health alone.
Lillia.combo: After Lillia W Watch Out! Eep! is down, close the gap with Shyvana R Dragon's Descent, slow her with Shyvana E Molten Burst, then activate Shyvana W Inferno Aegis and close in. Press Shyvana Q Emberstrike when a basic attack is ready to empower it. If Lillia tries to escape before the shield expires, recast Shyvana W Inferno Aegis to detonate it immediately.
Lillia.escape: The moment after you force Lillia to use Lillia W Watch Out! Eep! is your opening to engage. Keep dodging her abilities so she doesn't build move speed stacks, then follow with Shyvana W Inferno Aegis; if you're far away, close the gap with Shyvana R Dragon's Descent.
Lillia.fight: Approach with Shyvana W Inferno Aegis when Lillia has missed her abilities and has no move speed stacks. Right after Lillia W Watch Out! Eep! is used, close the gap with Shyvana R Dragon's Descent, land the slow from Shyvana E Molten Burst, then weave Shyvana Q Emberstrike into a basic attack. If Lillia looks likely to escape soon, recast Shyvana W Inferno Aegis to detonate it as soon as you close in.
Lillia.laning: When you don't know where Lillia is, don't pass straight through narrow jungle entrances or river paths where it's hard to dodge Lillia E Swirlseed. Before objectives, build up the Fury needed for Shyvana R Dragon's Descent and secure vision.
Lillia.phase: Shyvana should focus on farming and survive early rather than ganking. She gains the advantage as she stacks and the game goes on, but without enough Shyvana P Scalemail stacks and defensive items in the late game, she can be burst down first in a team fight.
Lillia.teamfight: Save an ally's immobilizing crowd control to catch Lillia when she flanks, then engage with Shyvana R Dragon's Descent after an ally locks her down. Angle Shyvana R Dragon's Descent to pass through several enemies, then hit clustered targets with Shyvana E Molten Burst. Land dragon-form Shyvana W Inferno Aegis's explosion on a champion to heal.
Lillia.watch: Hits from Lillia Q Blooming Blows and Lillia E Swirlseed make you a sleep target for Lillia R Lilting Lullaby, so dodge them even if you have plenty of health. When you see Lillia W Watch Out! Eep!'s cast animation, move sideways to avoid the center. If Lillia R Lilting Lullaby hits you, move to a safe spot during the drowsy window before you fall asleep.

MasterYi.build: You can't reduce the true damage from Master Yi E Wuju Style with armor, so build health too. If the healing from Master Yi W Meditate is a problem, fit Executioner's Calling in after completing one core item.
MasterYi.combo: Approach with Shyvana R Dragon's Descent right after Master Yi Q Alpha Strike ends, then close in with Shyvana W Inferno Aegis active. Follow with Shyvana E Molten Burst and weave Shyvana Q Emberstrike into a basic attack.
MasterYi.escape: The moment after Master Yi Q Alpha Strike is down is your chance to engage with Shyvana R Dragon's Descent. Close the gap while Master Yi has no mobility available, then hit your abilities after Q ends and he lands.
MasterYi.fight: After forcing Master Yi to use Master Yi Q Alpha Strike, close the gap with Shyvana R Dragon's Descent when he lands. Activate Shyvana W Inferno Aegis as you approach to use its shield and move speed, and use Shyvana Q Emberstrike with a basic attack. If Master Yi R Highlander is active, don't rely on the slow from Shyvana E Molten Burst.
MasterYi.laning: Master Yi is weak in the jungle early, so you can fight him if you encounter him, and secure vision to take early objectives first. Build up the Fury needed for Shyvana R Dragon's Descent before objective fights.
MasterYi.phase: Shyvana's stacks become more valuable as the game goes on, but Master Yi also gets stronger, so make up for your weak durability in the late game with P Scalemail stacks and defensive items.
MasterYi.teamfight: Group with your allies to deny Master Yi takedown participation, and time an ally's immobilizing crowd control to hit right after Master Yi Q Alpha Strike lands. Save an ally's crowd control to interrupt Master Yi W Meditate. After an ally catches him first, Shyvana should use R Dragon's Descent along a path that passes through several enemies, then land dragon-form W Inferno Aegis's explosion on a champion to heal.
MasterYi.watch: Master Yi can't be targeted while casting Master Yi Q Alpha Strike, so target him right after he lands. When Master Yi R Highlander is active, the slow from Shyvana E Molten Burst won't work. Also watch out for the true damage from Master Yi E Wuju Style.

MonkeyKing.build: Build armor first against Wukong's main damage. Wukong Q Crushing Blow reduces your armor, and Wukong R Cyclone deals damage based on your max health, so avoid stacking health alone. If Wukong's healing makes trades drag on, fit Executioner's Calling in after completing one core item.
MonkeyKing.combo: After Wukong W Warrior Trickster is down and you know where the real Wukong is, engage through him with Shyvana R Dragon's Descent. Slow Wukong as he circles out with Shyvana E Molten Burst, then weave Shyvana Q Emberstrike into a basic attack. If Wukong tries to escape before Shyvana W Inferno Aegis expires, recast it as soon as you close in to detonate it.
MonkeyKing.escape: Wukong can use both Wukong W Warrior Trickster and E Nimbus Strike for mobility, so don't go in as soon as just one is down. In particular, confirm the real Wukong's position and engage with Shyvana R Dragon's Descent before Wukong W Warrior Trickster comes off cooldown. Look for an objective or fight right after Wukong R Cyclone is down.
MonkeyKing.fight: Shyvana's magic damage is effective against Wukong's low magic resistance, so fight back with Shyvana W Inferno Aegis when he closes in and keep trades short. Wukong gains armor and healing the longer he fights, so don't let the fight drag on. After Wukong W Warrior Trickster is down, close the gap with Shyvana R Dragon's Descent.
MonkeyKing.laning: Start jungle camps with Shyvana E Molten Burst, activate Shyvana W Inferno Aegis and close in, then weave Shyvana Q Emberstrike into a basic attack.
MonkeyKing.phase: Farm and scale early, and avoid extended duels with Wukong. In the late game, Shyvana needs Shyvana P Scalemail stacks and defensive items to improve her durability and survive team fights.
MonkeyKing.teamfight: If Wukong R Cyclone is ready, spread out from allies so you aren't all knocked up together. After an ally applies crowd control, engage so several enemies are caught in Shyvana R Dragon's Descent's path, then hit clustered targets with Shyvana E Molten Burst. In dragon form, land Shyvana W Inferno Aegis's explosion on a champion to heal, and don't waste abilities on Wukong W Warrior Trickster's clone.
MonkeyKing.watch: Wukong E Nimbus Strike is targeted, so you can't dodge it while in range, and his follow-up Wukong Q Crushing Blow reduces your armor. Wukong W Warrior Trickster leaves a clone in place, so check which way the real Wukong moved before using Shyvana E Molten Burst. Wukong R Cyclone knocks up multiple enemies and can be recast, so spread out from allies while it's available.

Nocturne.build: Nocturne’s main damage is physical, so prioritize armor. Keep building armor stacks from Shyvana P Scalemail as well. If healing from Nocturne P Umbra Blades is a problem in fights, slot in Executioner's Calling after completing one core item.
Nocturne.combo: If Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness is active, use Shyvana E Molten Burst first to break the spell shield. Then close the gap with Shyvana R Dragon's Descent, activate Shyvana W Inferno Aegis to stick to him, and weave Shyvana Q Emberstrike into your attacks. Recast Shyvana W Inferno Aegis to hit with the explosion when Nocturne is about to escape; if he stays close, delay it to make longer use of the movement speed.
Nocturne.escape: When Nocturne R Paranoia is down, you have an opening to engage. If Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror is down too, close the gap with Shyvana R Dragon's Descent without worrying about the fear.
Nocturne.fight: Hold on by farming early, and look for fights once Shyvana R Dragon's Descent and your Fury are ready. If Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror tethers you, use Shyvana W Inferno Aegis to create distance and break the fear tether, or escape during the unstoppable window of Shyvana R Dragon's Descent. When fighting up close, time Shyvana Q Emberstrike with your attacks.
Nocturne.laning: Keep vision around the river and jungle entrances. Before Nocturne R Paranoia is activated, take a position from which you can fall back toward your allies. Build up the Fury needed for Shyvana R Dragon's Descent before starting Dragon or Herald.
Nocturne.phase: Shyvana peaks in the mid game once she has attack speed and core items. If you get through the early game and stack Shyvana P Scalemail, you gain an advantage as the game goes on, but without enough armor stacks and defensive items in the late game, you may melt first.
Nocturne.teamfight: When Nocturne R Paranoia darkens your screen, immediately group with your allies and don’t get isolated. After your allies apply crowd control, engage along a path that catches several enemies with Shyvana R Dragon's Descent. In dragon form, hit clustered enemies with Shyvana E Molten Burst and hit champions with the explosion from Shyvana W Inferno Aegis to heal.
Nocturne.watch: If Nocturne Q Duskbringer hits you, Nocturne can quickly approach along its trail, so don’t run in a straight line; turn toward your allies. Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror fears you if the tether holds, so use the movement speed from Shyvana W Inferno Aegis to create distance as soon as it connects. Don’t immediately use important abilities while Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness is active.

Nunu.build: To counter the healing from Nunu & Willump Q Consume, fit Executioner’s Calling into your build after completing one core item. Build magic resistance first against Nunu & Willump’s main ability damage, and get tenacity to counter the snowball’s crowd control.
Nunu.combo: To engage, close the gap with Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent, slow with Shyvana E Molten Burst, then activate Shyvana W Inferno Aegis and move in with basic attacks empowered by Shyvana Q Emberstrike. If Nunu & Willump looks likely to escape before the shield expires, recast Shyvana W Inferno Aegis to detonate it immediately. In dragon form, hit Nunu & Willump with the explosion to heal as well.
Nunu.escape: Your chance to engage comes after Nunu & Willump W Biggest Snowball Ever! and Nunu & Willump E Snowball Barrage are down. Nunu & Willump has no ability to create distance on its own, so pressure it by closing in with Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent. If you need to dodge the snowball, don’t rush your engage; move out of its path first.
Nunu.fight: Prioritize scaling over forced fights early, and engage once you have Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent and your Fury bar ready. If Nunu & Willump’s crowd control is down, close in with Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent, then follow the slow and max-health-based damage from Shyvana E Molten Burst with basic attacks empowered by Shyvana Q Emberstrike. Keep Nunu & Willump Q Consume’s healing in mind when judging trades.
Nunu.laning: Set up vision and build your Fury before fighting over an objective.
Nunu.phase: Look for fights and objective contests in the mid game, when Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent, attack speed, and core items are ready. If you survive the early game and build stacks, the matchup favors Shyvana more as it goes on. In the late game, though, you can be the first to melt in a team fight if you lack stacks and defensive items.
Nunu.teamfight: When Nunu & Willump R Absolute Zero begins, move out of its area; Shyvana has no immobilizing crowd control to interrupt it. After an ally applies crowd control, engage along a path that carries Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent through multiple enemies, then hit grouped enemies with the piercing Shyvana E Molten Burst. Hit champions with the Shyvana W Inferno Aegis explosion in dragon form to heal and stay alive.
Nunu.watch: Nunu & Willump W Biggest Snowball Ever! rolls in from far away and knocks you up, so secure river vision early, step aside, and pass toward the direction it is coming from. Nunu & Willump E Snowball Barrage roots you after a delay, so move away immediately if it hits you. When Nunu & Willump R Absolute Zero begins, leave its area before the slow intensifies.

Poppy.build: Build armor first against Poppy’s main damage. Poppy Q Hammer Shock deals damage based on your max health, so avoid stacking health alone. Don’t spend resources on magic resistance just for Poppy.
Poppy.combo: Once Poppy W Steadfast Presence ends and Poppy E Heroic Charge is down, close the gap with Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent. Then slow her with Shyvana E Molten Burst, close in with Shyvana W Inferno Aegis, and use a basic attack empowered by Shyvana Q Emberstrike. If Poppy looks likely to escape before the shield expires, recast Shyvana W Inferno Aegis to detonate it.
Poppy.escape: The moment after you make Poppy use Poppy E Heroic Charge is your chance to close the gap. However, if Poppy W Steadfast Presence is active, wait to engage with Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent until it ends, then go in from open space.
Poppy.fight: Focus on scaling early instead of forcing fights. When fighting, wait for Poppy W Steadfast Presence to end, then close in with Shyvana W Inferno Aegis. Follow the slow from Shyvana E Molten Burst with a basic attack empowered by Shyvana Q Emberstrike. Poppy gains armor as her health gets low, so only chase deep when you can secure the kill.
Poppy.laning: Move into open space so Poppy E Heroic Charge can’t knock you into a wall. When Poppy’s thrown shield lands, step on it first to prevent her from gaining a shield.
Poppy.phase: Shyvana’s ganks are weak early, so farm and endure. Shyvana’s matchup against Poppy improves as she stacks, but in the late game, you can be the first to fall in a team fight if you lack Shyvana P Scalemail stacks and defensive items.
Poppy.teamfight: While Poppy W Steadfast Presence is active, wait to engage with Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent. After an ally applies crowd control, take a path that carries you through multiple enemies. In dragon form, hit grouped enemies with Shyvana E Molten Burst, then hit champions with the Shyvana W Inferno Aegis explosion to heal. When you see Poppy R Keeper’s Verdict charging, move sideways out of its path to avoid being knocked away.
Poppy.watch: While Poppy W Steadfast Presence is active, don’t engage with Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent. Wait for the effect to end or walk up instead. Poppy E Heroic Charge stuns you if it knocks you into a wall, so stay in open space. If Poppy Q Hammer Shock hits you, leave the lingering zone immediately. When you see Poppy R Keeper’s Verdict charging, move sideways out of its path.

Rammus.build: Build magic resistance first against the magic damage from Rammus Q Powerball, Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl, and Rammus R Soaring Slam. Keep building resistance stacks from Shyvana P Scalemail to improve your late-game durability.
Rammus.combo: After Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl ends, close the gap with Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent, slow with Shyvana E Molten Burst, then use a basic attack empowered by Shyvana Q Emberstrike. If Rammus looks likely to escape soon, recast Shyvana W Inferno Aegis as soon as you close in to detonate it. If he stays close, delay the detonation to use the movement speed boost.
Rammus.escape: The window after Rammus R Soaring Slam is down is your chance to close the gap with Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent. Stay out of range before Rammus E Frenzying Taunt hits, and if it catches you, be ready to move as soon as it ends.
Rammus.fight: Stop basic attacking while Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl is active; hit another target or create distance. Once it ends, hit with the slow and max-health-based damage from Shyvana E Molten Burst, then focus your damage with a basic attack empowered by Shyvana Q Emberstrike.
Rammus.phase: Shyvana’s ganks are weak early, so farm and endure. If you survive the early game, the matchup against Rammus favors you more as it goes on. In the late game, use Shyvana P Scalemail stacks and defensive items to make up for your low health growth.
Rammus.teamfight: If Rammus rolls in quickly with Rammus Q Powerball, give Rammus R Soaring Slam’s landing area plenty of room, then leave the landing spot immediately. After an ally applies crowd control, engage along a path that carries Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent through multiple enemies, then hit grouped enemies with the piercing Shyvana E Molten Burst. If Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl is active, don’t focus your basic attacks on him.
Rammus.watch: When you see Rammus Q Powerball, put minions between you to block the collision, and move away from the wide landing area of Rammus R Soaring Slam. Rammus E Frenzying Taunt is targeted and unavoidable, so stay out of range. If it catches you, plan when to escape with Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent after it ends.

RekSai.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Rek’Sai Q Queen’s Wrath / Prey Seeker, Rek’Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel, and Rek’Sai R Void Rush. Rek’Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel deals true damage that resistances can’t reduce, and Rek’Sai R Void Rush deals damage based on max health, so be careful about stacking health alone. If healing from Rek’Sai P Fury of the Xer’Sai prolongs fights, fit Executioner’s Calling into your build after completing one core item.
RekSai.combo: Activate Shyvana W Inferno Aegis, close in, and use a basic attack empowered by Shyvana Q Emberstrike. If Rek’Sai looks likely to escape before the shield expires, recast Shyvana W Inferno Aegis to detonate it.
RekSai.escape: The moment after you dodge the knock-up from Rek’Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow is your chance to go in. If only Rek’Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel is down, Rek’Sai may escape with another mobility option, so look to close the gap with Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent before Rek’Sai R Void Rush is available again.
RekSai.fight: Farm while watching for Rek’Sai’s early ganks, and start fights once Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent is ready. If Rek’Sai burrows with Rek’Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow, dodge the knock-up or break through it with Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent. Once you’re in, keep close with Shyvana W Inferno Aegis and continue dealing damage with the slow from Shyvana E Molten Burst and basic attacks empowered by Shyvana Q Emberstrike.
RekSai.laning: Don’t move alone through areas without vision. Walk over visible Rek’Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel entrances near lanes or in your jungle to destroy them. Once Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent is available, build your Fury and set up vision to start Dragon and Rift Herald first.
RekSai.phase: Rek’Sai’s early ganks are threatening and Shyvana’s are weak, so grow without giving up kills. The longer the game goes, the more the matchup favors Shyvana. In the late game, though, you can be the first to melt in a team fight if you lack Shyvana P Scalemail stacks and defensive items.
RekSai.teamfight: After an ally applies crowd control, engage along a path that carries Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent through multiple enemies. In dragon form, pierce grouped enemies with Shyvana E Molten Burst, and hit champions with the Shyvana W Inferno Aegis explosion to heal. Build your Fury before fights around objectives.
RekSai.watch: Rek’Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow can catch you with a knock-up, so when Rek’Sai burrows, move toward open space and avoid walls and narrow paths. If you expect a knock-up, you can break through it during Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent’s unstoppable window. Stay close to allies after Rek’Sai damages you, since Rek’Sai R Void Rush can follow up.

Rengar.build: Build armor first against Rengar’s main damage. If healing from Rengar W Battle Roar prolongs the fight, fit Executioner’s Calling into your build after completing one core item.
Rengar.combo: Approach with Shyvana W Inferno Aegis, dodge Rengar E Bola Strike, then close the gap with Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent. Follow with the slow from Shyvana E Molten Burst and a basic attack empowered by Shyvana Q Emberstrike. If Rengar tries to escape before the shield expires, recast Shyvana W Inferno Aegis to detonate it.
Rengar.escape: Engage with Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent during the window after Rengar E Bola Strike is down. Once you confirm Rengar has also used Rengar W Battle Roar, focus your damage while he can’t heal.
Rengar.fight: Trade when Rengar’s Ferocity bar is empty, right after he uses Rengar W Battle Roar. After dodging Rengar E Bola Strike, close in with Shyvana W Inferno Aegis and attack with the slow from Shyvana E Molten Burst and basic attacks empowered by Shyvana Q Emberstrike.
Rengar.laning: Avoid paths beside bushes where Rengar could be hiding, and use a Control Ward to get vision of the bushes.
Rengar.phase: Early on, prioritize Shyvana’s growth while watching for Rengar’s bush leaps and empowered abilities. If you survive the early game and build Shyvana P Scalemail stacks, the matchup favors you more as it goes on. In the late game, you can melt first if you lack stacks and defensive items.
Rengar.teamfight: Position your allies so the back line stays in vision behind the front line, preparing for Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt’s leap. After you counter his engage, wait for an ally to apply crowd control, then engage along a path that carries Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent through multiple enemies. Hit champions with the Shyvana W Inferno Aegis explosion in dragon form to heal, and attack grouped enemies with Shyvana E Molten Burst.
Rengar.watch: Rengar can leap from bushes with Rengar P Unseen Predator and generate Ferocity, so avoid bush edges when he’s out of sight. When his Ferocity bar is full, Rengar E Bola Strike can root you, so let it pass before using a mobility ability. Watch for Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt and don’t roam alone while injured.

Sejuani.build: Build magic resistance first against Sejuani’s main damage. Sejuani W Winter’s Wrath deals physical damage, which magic resistance can’t block. If you’re often caught by crowd control, prioritize tenacity as well. Improve your late game durability with Shyvana P Scalemail stacks and defensive items.
Sejuani.combo: Once Sejuani Q Arctic Assault is down, engage with Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent. Then slow her with Shyvana E Molten Burst, activate Shyvana W Inferno Aegis to close in, and use a basic attack empowered by Shyvana Q Emberstrike. If Sejuani looks likely to escape before the shield expires, recast Shyvana W Inferno Aegis to detonate it.
Sejuani.escape: The moment after Sejuani uses Sejuani Q Arctic Assault is your chance to engage with Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent. If an engage crowd control ability like Sejuani R Glacial Prison is still available, decide whether to break through it during Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent’s unstoppable window.
Sejuani.fight: Right after Sejuani Q Arctic Assault is down, close the gap with Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent. If Sejuani’s Frost Armor is active, hit her first with Shyvana E Molten Burst; use the slow once her armor is gone. Once in range, use Shyvana Q Emberstrike with a basic attack, and hit a champion with the Shyvana W Inferno Aegis explosion to heal.
Sejuani.laning: Look for Sejuani’s opposite-side camps when there’s an opening created by her weak early game, and secure vision to start Dragon or Rift Herald first. Build the Fury needed for Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent before objective fights.
Sejuani.phase: Early on, farm and endure, while taking advantage of Sejuani’s weak early game to contest camps and objectives. The more stacks you build, the more this matchup favors Shyvana as it goes on. In the late game, though, you can be the first to fall in a team fight if you lack Shyvana P Scalemail stacks and defensive items.
Sejuani.teamfight: After an ally applies crowd control, choose a Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent path that carries you through multiple enemies. In dragon form, pierce grouped enemies with Shyvana E Molten Burst, and hit champions with the Shyvana W Inferno Aegis explosion to heal. Create distance as Sejuani E Permafrost stacks build, and watch for engages from Sejuani Q Arctic Assault and Sejuani R Glacial Prison.
Sejuani.watch: Sejuani Q Arctic Assault charges in and knocks you up, while Sejuani R Glacial Prison stuns, so watch for their tells and sidestep. If Sejuani W Winter’s Wrath hits you with its first strike, get out of range before its second strike slows you. When Sejuani and her melee allies attack together, they build stacks toward Sejuani E Permafrost’s stun, so create distance as the stacks build.

Shaco.build: Build magic resistance first against the magic damage from Shaco W Jack In The Box, Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison, and Shaco R Hallucinate. Get enough health to avoid the health threshold where Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison deals more damage. Stack Shyvana P Scalemail to gain armor and magic resistance.
Shaco.combo: Slow Shaco with Shyvana E Molten Burst, activate Shyvana W Inferno Aegis to close in, then use a basic attack empowered by Shyvana Q Emberstrike. If Shaco looks likely to run before the shield expires, recast Shyvana W Inferno Aegis to detonate it.
Shaco.escape: The moment after Shaco Q Deceive is down is your window to engage with Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent. Check paths where you suspect Shaco W Jack In The Box first. If the fear is hard to avoid, time your engage to use Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent’s unstoppable window.
Shaco.fight: Early on, grow without giving up kills to Shaco’s ganks or invades. Right after Shaco appears with Shaco Q Deceive, he can’t use the same ability to escape immediately, so focus him with your allies. If Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent is ready, engage during that window, close in with Shyvana W Inferno Aegis, and use a basic attack empowered by Shyvana Q Emberstrike.
Shaco.laning: Maintain vision at your jungle entrances to prepare for Shaco’s early invades and ganks. To start an objective first, check for nearby Shaco W Jack In The Box and build the Fury needed for Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent.
Shaco.phase: Shaco’s early ganks and invades are threatening, so Shyvana should endure by farming and securing vision. Shaco’s ability to fight alone falls off over time, but Shyvana can still be the first to fall in a late game team fight if she lacks Shyvana P Scalemail stacks and defensive items.
Shaco.teamfight: After an ally applies crowd control, find an angle for Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent to pass through multiple enemies. Focus the Shaco who appears with Shaco Q Deceive immediately with your allies, but watch health bar reactions so you don’t waste damage on Shaco R Hallucinate’s clone. If you kill the clone, step back to avoid the explosion and box fear.
Shaco.watch: Watch out for fear from Shaco W Jack In The Box in bushes without vision and around objectives. Check with a Control Ward or Oracle Lens before approaching. If Shaco Q Deceive gets him behind you, his empowered basic attacks are dangerous, so stand with your back to a wall or turn toward your allies when he’s nearby. When your health is low after a fight, avoid paths without vision so you don’t get hit by Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison.

Skarner.build: First decide whether you need a way to break Skarner R Impale’s suppression. If so, add Quicksilver Sash or Mercurial Scimitar to your build. Prioritize magic resistance against the damage from Skarner P Threads of Vibration, W Seismic Bastion, and R Impale. Magic resistance won’t stop Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval or E Ixtal's Impact, and stacking health alone also increases the damage you take from max health-based damage.
Skarner.combo: When Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is down, close the gap with Shyvana R Dragon's Descent and slow him with Shyvana E Molten Burst. Activate Shyvana W Inferno Aegis, stick to him, and weave Shyvana Q Emberstrike into your attacks. If Skarner looks likely to escape before the shield expires, recast Shyvana W Inferno Aegis to detonate it.
Skarner.escape: Go in right after Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is down. If you were also stunned by a wall collision, Skarner E Ixtal's Impact will come back sooner, so back off with his next charge in mind. Once Skarner R Impale has suppressed you, you can’t escape with Shyvana R Dragon's Descent.
Skarner.fight: Right after you force Skarner to use E Ixtal's Impact is your chance to close the gap with Shyvana R Dragon's Descent. Follow up with Shyvana E Molten Burst to slow him, then use Shyvana W Inferno Aegis to stick to him and weave Shyvana Q Emberstrike into your attacks. Avoid trades where you keep taking empowered attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval.
Skarner.laning: Set up vision so you can start objectives first and delay Skarner’s item spikes. Before a fight, build up the Fury for Shyvana R Dragon's Descent. Around objectives, don’t stand at the edge of the pit where Skarner R Impale can drag you inside.
Skarner.phase: Early on, Shyvana should farm and hold on rather than look for ganks, building stacks of Shyvana P Scalemail. A stacked Shyvana can gain the advantage later, but without enough stacks and defensive items in the late game, you’ll be the first to melt in teamfights.
Skarner.teamfight: Stand with your back to a wall or at the edge of an objective pit to avoid being dragged away by Skarner E Ixtal's Impact and R Impale. After your allies apply crowd control, use Shyvana R Dragon's Descent along a path that catches several enemies, then hit clustered targets with Shyvana E Molten Burst. In dragon form, hit champions with the explosion from Shyvana W Inferno Aegis to heal.

Taliyah.build: Build magic resistance first against the magic damage from Taliyah Q Threaded Volley and Taliyah E Unraveled Earth. Shyvana P Scalemail stacks permanently increase armor and magic resistance, so build them by helping kill large monsters.
Taliyah.combo: Take a path that avoids the minefield from Taliyah E Unraveled Earth as you pass through Taliyah with Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent. As Taliyah turns back, slow her with Shyvana E Molten Burst and time Shyvana Q Emberstrike with your next basic attack. If she looks likely to escape soon after you close in, recast Shyvana W Inferno Aegis to detonate it immediately.
Taliyah.escape: Look for an engage after Taliyah E Unraveled Earth is down and before Taliyah R Weaver’s Wall is available again. If only one ability is down, she can escape with the other, so don’t rush Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent. Approach at an angle that keeps you from standing between Taliyah and the minefield, while watching for Taliyah W Seismic Shove.
Taliyah.fight: If Taliyah R Weaver’s Wall is down, it’s a chance to close the gap with Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent.
Taliyah.laning: Early on, clear camps and grow by invading camps on the opposite side while building Shyvana P Scalemail stacks.
