If Taliyah disappears from the jungle, watch for Taliyah P Rock Surfing, which makes her faster near walls, and for her to impact other lanes with Taliyah R Weaver’s Wall. Set up vision to start Dragon or Rift Herald first, and build the Fury needed for Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent before objective fights.
Taliyah.phase: The matchup against Taliyah favors Shyvana more as she stacks, but in the late game, Shyvana can be the first to melt in a team fight if she lacks Shyvana P Scalemail stacks and defensive items.
Taliyah.teamfight: After an ally applies crowd control, engage along a path that carries Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent through multiple enemies. Shyvana E Molten Burst in dragon form pierces, so use it on grouped enemies, and hit champions with the Shyvana W Inferno Aegis explosion to heal. Before engaging, check for the minefield from Taliyah E Unraveled Earth and avoid paths across it.
Taliyah.watch: Taliyah can’t change the cast direction of Taliyah Q Threaded Volley, so sidestep instead of moving in a straight line. Avoid paths through the minefield when engaging with Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent as well.

Udyr.build: Prioritize armor. Also account for the magic damage from Udyr R Wingborne Storm and both damage types from Udyr Q Wilding Claw; avoid stacking health alone. If healing from Udyr W Iron Mantle prolongs the fight, slot in Executioner's Calling after completing one core item.
Udyr.combo: When Udyr E Blazing Stampede is down, close the gap with Shyvana R Dragon's Descent. Follow up with Shyvana E Molten Burst to slow him, then activate Shyvana W Inferno Aegis, stick to him, and weave Shyvana Q Emberstrike into your attacks. If Udyr looks likely to escape before the shield expires, recast Shyvana W Inferno Aegis to detonate it.
Udyr.escape: Right after you force Udyr to use E Blazing Stampede is your window to go in with Shyvana R Dragon's Descent. If you’ve already been stunned by Udyr E Blazing Stampede, he can’t stun the same target again for a while, so counterattack or escape during that window.
Udyr.fight: Prioritize growth early and start fights once you have Shyvana R Dragon's Descent. When Udyr W Iron Mantle’s shield is gone, slow him with Shyvana E Molten Burst and pressure him with basic attacks empowered by Shyvana Q Emberstrike.
Udyr.phase: Shyvana should hold on by farming early and fight hard in the mid game once she has attack speed and core items. Against Udyr, stacking Shyvana P Scalemail makes you stronger as the game goes on, but without enough stacks and defensive items in the late game, you may be the first to fall in a teamfight.
Udyr.teamfight: Don’t force Udyr as your first kill target when he has defensive items and the shield from Udyr W Iron Mantle. After your allies apply crowd control, use Shyvana R Dragon's Descent at an angle that passes through several enemies, then hit champions with the piercing Shyvana E Molten Burst and the explosion from Shyvana W Inferno Aegis.
Udyr.watch: Be wary of the stun on Udyr’s first attack right after he activates E Blazing Stampede. Udyr Q Wilding Claw and R Wingborne Storm deal max health-based damage, so watch out when you’re tanking them for a long time with Shyvana W Inferno Aegis.

Vi.build: Prioritize armor against Vi’s main damage. Vi W Denting Blows deals max health-based damage and reduces armor, so avoid stacking health alone. Since basic attacks and attack speed are central to her damage, reducing her attack speed is also effective.
Vi.combo: When Vi Q Vault Breaker is down, close the gap with Shyvana R Dragon's Descent, slow her with Shyvana E Molten Burst, then weave Shyvana Q Emberstrike into your attacks. Keep Shyvana W Inferno Aegis active while you stick to her, then recast it to detonate before Vi escapes.
Vi.escape: Right after Vi Q Vault Breaker is down is your chance to go in with Shyvana R Dragon's Descent. Don’t try to stop Vi R Cease and Desist with forced movement while she’s charging at you; respond after she lands and the knockup ends.
Vi.fight: Right after dodging Vi Q Vault Breaker or forcing her to use it, close the gap with Shyvana R Dragon's Descent. If Vi P Blast Shield is active, begin trading once it has been removed. Fight briefly before Vi W Denting Blows stacks up, then use the movement speed from Shyvana W Inferno Aegis to create distance.
Vi.laning: When you see Vi charging Q Vault Breaker, move backward or to the side to dodge it, and look for a fight after Vi P Blast Shield has been removed.
Vi.phase: Early on, Shyvana should focus on farming rather than ganking, while dodging Vi Q Vault Breaker and holding on. Shyvana’s accumulated Shyvana P Scalemail stacks pay off later, but without enough stacks and defensive items, you can melt first in a teamfight.
Vi.teamfight: While Vi R Cease and Desist is available, keep your backline carries from wandering out of vision alone and keep them within range of allied protection abilities. After your allies apply crowd control, use Shyvana R Dragon's Descent along a path that catches several enemies, then hit clustered targets with Shyvana E Molten Burst. In dragon form, hit champions with the explosion from Shyvana W Inferno Aegis to heal.
Vi.watch: Vi Q Vault Breaker deals more damage the longer it’s charged, so move backward or to the side when you see her windup. Vi W Denting Blows reduces a target’s armor and increases Vi’s attack speed as she hits them repeatedly, so don’t stay in a prolonged fight. Vi R Cease and Desist chases its target to the end and stuns and knocks them up, so don’t wander off alone while Vi has it available.

Viego.build: Prioritize armor against Viego Q Blade of the Ruined King and R Heartbreaker, his main sources of damage. Keep building armor stacks from Shyvana P Scalemail as well. If healing from Viego P Sovereign's Domination and Q Blade of the Ruined King makes duels drag on, slot in Executioner's Calling after completing one core item.
Viego.combo: When an opening to engage appears, close the gap with Shyvana R Dragon's Descent, slow him with Shyvana E Molten Burst, then weave Shyvana Q Emberstrike into your attacks. Activate Shyvana W Inferno Aegis as you approach, and if Viego looks ready to escape, recast it as soon as you’re close to detonate it. In dragon form, hit Viego with the explosion to heal.
Viego.escape: When Viego W Spectral Maw is down, you have an opening to engage, but Viego can still escape with R Heartbreaker if it’s available. Close the gap with Shyvana R Dragon's Descent, especially before Viego R Heartbreaker comes back up.
Viego.fight: Avoid forced skirmishes early and focus on scaling. When you fight, use Shyvana W Inferno Aegis to approach and shield yourself, slow him with Shyvana E Molten Burst, then weave Shyvana Q Emberstrike into your attacks. If you’ve stuck to Viego before he can escape, recast Shyvana W Inferno Aegis to detonate it.
Viego.laning: Avoid routes where you see the black mist from Viego E Harrowed Path, and don’t push the wave in that direction.
Viego.phase: Shyvana peaks in the mid game once she has attack speed and core items. Her stacking advantage grows over time, but without enough Shyvana P Scalemail stacks and defensive items in the late game, you may be the first to fall in a teamfight.
Viego.teamfight: After your allies apply crowd control, use Shyvana R Dragon's Descent along a path that catches several enemies. In dragon form, hit clustered enemies with Shyvana E Molten Burst and hit champions with the explosion from Shyvana W Inferno Aegis to heal. Fight at a distance from fallen allies so Viego can’t possess them with P Sovereign's Domination.
Viego.watch: Viego W Spectral Maw’s stun lasts longer the more it’s charged, so move to the side when you see him charging. If you see the black mist from Viego E Harrowed Path along terrain, Viego may be camouflaged there, so avoid that route. When your health is low, fall back because you’re an easy target for Viego R Heartbreaker.

Warwick.build: Prioritize magic resistance against the main damage from Warwick P Eternal Hunger, Q Jaws of the Beast, and R Infinite Duress. Build armor against his basic attack damage as well. If healing prolongs duels, slot in Executioner's Calling after completing one core item.
Warwick.combo: Follow up with Shyvana E Molten Burst to slow him, then activate Shyvana W Inferno Aegis, stick to him, and weave Shyvana Q Emberstrike into your basic attacks. If Warwick looks likely to escape before the shield expires, recast Shyvana W Inferno Aegis to detonate it.
Warwick.escape: If you engage just because Warwick Q Jaws of the Beast is down, he can escape with Warwick R Infinite Duress. Go in with Shyvana R Dragon's Descent during the window when both Warwick E Primal Howl’s fear and Warwick R Infinite Duress are down.
Warwick.fight: Don’t commit your damage while Warwick E Primal Howl is active; reengage and trade after the fear goes off. Slow him with Shyvana E Molten Burst and time Shyvana Q Emberstrike with your next basic attack. Even as Warwick’s health decreases, his healing grows stronger, so don’t chase deep based on his health alone.
Warwick.laning: Look for chances to invade using lane priority while Warwick is slow to clear the jungle. If your health drops below half and Warwick W Blood Hunt exposes you, give up some farm and recall.
Warwick.phase: Early on, Shyvana should hold on by farming and manage her health so Warwick doesn’t get a kill. Building Shyvana P Scalemail stacks from the early game gives you an advantage later, but without enough stacks and defensive items in the late game, you may be the first to fall in a teamfight.
Warwick.teamfight: Warwick R Infinite Duress leaps farther with higher movement speed, so watch the opposite side of the objective pit and areas without vision during standoffs. After your allies apply crowd control, use Shyvana R Dragon's Descent along a path that passes through several enemies, then layer the piercing damage and slow from Shyvana E Molten Burst. Fight while hitting champions with the explosion from Shyvana W Inferno Aegis in dragon form to heal.
Warwick.watch: Warwick W Blood Hunt reveals Shyvana’s location when her health drops below half and increases Warwick’s movement and attack speed. While Warwick E Primal Howl is active, the damage he takes is greatly reduced and fear follows, so use the movement speed from Shyvana W Inferno Aegis to create distance, then reengage after the fear is down. If Warwick R Infinite Duress hits you, you are suppressed and can act, so watch for him to leap from out of vision during objective standoffs.

XinZhao.build: Prioritize armor against Xin Zhao’s main damage. If healing from Xin Zhao P Determination prolongs fights, slot in Executioner's Calling after completing one core item.
XinZhao.combo: When Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge is down, engage with Shyvana R Dragon's Descent. Slow him with Shyvana E Molten Burst, then activate Shyvana W Inferno Aegis, stick to him, and weave Shyvana Q Emberstrike into your attacks. If Xin Zhao looks likely to escape before the shield expires, recast Shyvana W Inferno Aegis to detonate it.
XinZhao.escape: Right after you force Xin Zhao to use E Audacious Charge is your chance to go in with Shyvana R Dragon's Descent. Conversely, if you’ve been hit twice by the empowered attacks from Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike, use Shyvana R Dragon's Descent to create distance before the third attack.
XinZhao.fight: Early on, watch out for Xin Zhao’s dash and third empowered attack, and avoid prolonged fights. Right after Xin Zhao uses E Audacious Charge, close the gap with Shyvana R Dragon's Descent, slow him with Shyvana E Molten Burst, then weave Shyvana Q Emberstrike into your attacks. If Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard is active, counterattack after its immunity window ends.
XinZhao.laning: Use the movement speed from Shyvana W Inferno Aegis to move quickly between camps and gain farm by invading the camps on the opposite side. Before an objective fight, build up the Fury needed for Shyvana R Dragon's Descent and secure vision.
XinZhao.phase: Shyvana is strong in the mid game once she has attack speed and core items. You can build an advantage with P Scalemail stacks in the late game, but without enough stacks and defensive items, you may melt first in a teamfight.
XinZhao.teamfight: If Xin Zhao is likely to engage, don’t stand too close to your allies, reducing the harm caused by Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard’s knockback splitting your formation. After your allies apply crowd control, use Shyvana R Dragon's Descent along a path that catches several enemies, then attack clustered targets with Shyvana E Molten Burst in dragon form. Hit champions with the explosion from Shyvana W Inferno Aegis to heal, and counterattack when Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard ends.
XinZhao.watch: Move to the side to dodge the second-stage thrust from Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning. If you’ve been hit twice by the empowered attacks from Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike, get out of range with Shyvana R Dragon's Descent before the third attack knocks you up. While Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard is active, don’t try to deal damage from outside his spear’s range.

Zac.build: Complete one core item first, then slot in Executioner's Calling if healing from Zac P Cell Division remains a problem. Build magic resistance rather than armor to withstand damage from Zac Q Stretching Strikes, W Unstable Matter, and E Elastic Slingshot. Don’t focus only on stacking health; use the movement speed from Shyvana W Inferno Aegis to leave the spot where his engage is telegraphed.
Zac.combo: When Zac E Elastic Slingshot is down, engage with Shyvana R Dragon's Descent, slow him with Shyvana E Molten Burst, then weave Shyvana Q Emberstrike into your attacks. Keep Shyvana W Inferno Aegis active while you fight up close, and recast it to detonate immediately if Zac looks likely to escape before it explodes. When the revival effect of Zac P Cell Division triggers, use area damage to clear the split blobs together once they come close.
Zac.escape: Zac E Elastic Slingshot is his means of movement, so right after he uses it is your chance to go in with Shyvana R Dragon's Descent. If Zac still has E, watch his charge and landing spot, and use the unstoppable window of Shyvana R Dragon's Descent to engage.
Zac.fight: It’s best to close the gap with Shyvana R Dragon's Descent right after Zac E Elastic Slingshot is down. Slow him with Shyvana E Molten Burst, then weave Shyvana Q Emberstrike into your attacks while you’re close. If Zac moves to pick up a blob, step on it first to stop his healing.
Zac.laning: Start clearing camps with Shyvana E Molten Burst, activate Shyvana W Inferno Aegis as you close in, then weave Shyvana Q Emberstrike into your attacks.
Zac.phase: Early on, Shyvana should farm and hold on rather than gank, building stacks of Shyvana P Scalemail. Stacking it gives you an advantage against Zac as the game goes on, but without enough durability in the late game, you may be the first to fall in a teamfight, so build stacks and defensive items.
Zac.teamfight: Watch for Zac E Elastic Slingshot’s engage. After your allies apply crowd control, go in along a path that catches several enemies with Shyvana R Dragon's Descent. Use Shyvana E Molten Burst in dragon form on clustered enemies, and hit champions with the explosion from Shyvana W Inferno Aegis to heal. Step on blobs dropped by Zac P Cell Division to deny healing, and use area damage to clear the split blobs from his revive once they come close.
Zac.watch: Zac E Elastic Slingshot has a visible charge and knocks you up on landing, so avoid the landing spot when you see him charging from behind a wall. After being hit by the slow and knockup from Zac Q Stretching Strikes, staying close makes it easy to also take the max health-based damage from Zac W Unstable Matter. During the fight, step on the blobs dropped by Zac P Cell Division to deny his healing.
